_comment: Copy to rules.json in the tool folder (the guided mode loads it automatically) or pass --config. Keys starting with _ are ignored. See docs/06-how-it-works.md.
_comment_extra_opportunity_keywords: A subject containing any of these scores +7 (enough for the share sheet on its own).
_comment_extra_ignore_keywords: A subject containing any of these scores -10.
_comment_pitch_domains: Sender domains of paid 'training & internship' programmes that keep reaching students.
_comment_campus_keywords: Subject words that make a mail from your own institution campus-only (fest names, internal events).
_comment_placement_senders: Exact addresses of your placement cell, if the built-in patterns (cdc, tpo, tnp, placement, career...) miss them.
_comment_share_placement_cell: false keeps your placement cell's own notices out of the share file.
